title: Computation of the Late Fee on a Retrofit Project Account
content:
# Computation of the Late Fee on a Retrofit Project Account

The late fee owed on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects whose billings have run past their due day is worked out from the amount the fee is taken on, the monthly rate the fee is charged at and the months the amount has stood overdue.

## The amount the fee is taken on

The amount the fee is taken on is everything billed on the project by way of deposit, mobilisation, progress and change order billings, less every payment received.

## The clock and the months

The overdue clock runs from the day the most recent progress billing fell due, and the days overdue are the calendar days from that day to the day the fee is raised. The months overdue are counted as one month, that is as 1 month.

## The rate

The monthly rate is the rate the project's class charges for each month, with nothing added to it: the whole of that rate, 100 per cent of it, and 0 percentage points added.

## The fee and its ceiling

The fee before the ceiling is the amount the fee is taken on, multiplied by the monthly rate and by the months overdue, rounded to the nearest cent. The ceiling on the fee is 2 per cent of the amount the fee is taken on. The late fee raised is the smaller of the fee before the ceiling and that ceiling, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A project whose class charges 1.5 per cent per month, with deposit, mobilisation, progress and change order billings of USD 180000 and payments received of USD 60000:

| Step | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| amount the fee is taken on | 180000 less 60000 | USD 120000.00 |
| months overdue | as counted | 1 |
| fee before the ceiling | 120000 at 1.5 per cent for one month | USD 1800.00 |
| ceiling | 2 per cent of 120000 | USD 2400.00 |
| late fee raised | the smaller of the two | USD 1800.00 |

On the same project with billings of USD 400000 and no payments received, the fee before the ceiling would be USD 6000.00 and the ceiling USD 8000.00, so USD 6000.00 is raised; where the class charged 3 per cent per month the fee before the ceiling would be USD 12000.00 and the ceiling would govern at USD 8000.00.
